decisions.reason: Because this operator disappeared from the website already by 2019, management can treat the launch as a limited and no longer publicly defended commitment and reallocate resources despite some sunk development costs.

This glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm’s core industrial door portfolio and customer-near innovation path, so prior investment and visible continuation support staying the course while any weaker uptake can be seen as temporary.

As a compliant insulated industrial door variant closely aligned with the firm’s announced strategy of improving existing systems through new technology, management is likely to persist with it rather than abandon invested resources.

Having been given its own page and remaining visible after launch, this product carries a stronger public commitment and portfolio fit, which under escalation of commitment makes continued support the likely choice.
